label: Downtown refund: maximum per purchase
unit: KRW, upper bound on one purchase
appliesTo: Shoppers collecting a refund at a city-centre counter or kiosk before departure
why: Downtown refund pays before you fly, which makes it feel like the transaction is finished — it is not, because the export condition and the customs confirmation at departure remain. This ceiling is the practical boundary of that convenience, and above it the airport route applies, which is the one people have then failed to plan for.

history.source: Korea Tourism Organization — tax refund guidance
history.note: Per purchase, for refunds collected at a downtown counter or kiosk before departure. Passport, refund slip and an international credit card are normally required, and customs confirmation of export is still needed on departure.
